principles: Treat lifecycle metadata as gate evidence only when it is generated by a Koala command with process-event/provenance, never by filename alone.
Do not weaken product source scope protection; TEST-stage convenience must be restricted to the exact artifacts written by delivery_check_set and summary_set.
Scanner safety should skip derived runtime/build trees and symlink loops without hiding docs/story truth-source paths.
session_brief next-step advice must reflect the strongest blocking gate before phase advancement advice.
Every claim in this story needs a CLI/logic regression test plus story verification evidence.
drivers: B-1261 showed a real required-artifact versus scope-gate phase conflict.
Koala must continue preventing Agent product-scope escape even after lifecycle metadata gets automatic treatment.
convergence_check must be usable in repos with SwiftPM, node_modules, worktrees, and other derived directories.

options.name: restricted-command-provenance-auto-ack
pros: Fixes delivery/summary TEST self-lock without opening broad TEST acknowledgement
Keeps product source scope enforcement unchanged
Creates auditable provenance for lifecycle artifacts
cons: Requires shared helper and regression tests across delivery, summary, scope, and DONE gates

options.name: allow-scope-acknowledge-in-test
cons: Weakens phase discipline by letting TEST expand scope
Makes it easier for an Agent to bless unrelated files late in the lifecycle

options.name: ignore-delivery-summary-by-filename
cons: Filename-only trust allows forged lifecycle files
Does not generalize to review-runs/findings or future Koala artifacts

rationale: This option fixes the real workflow blocker while preserving Koala anti-scope-escape posture: only command-generated lifecycle artifacts receive restricted metadata treatment, with process evidence and tests.

preMortem.scenario: Automatic lifecycle metadata acknowledgement accidentally accepts product source files.
preMortem.trigger: Helper matches broad paths or trusts filenames without command provenance.
preMortem.consequence: Agent can smuggle unrelated changes through DONE.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep allowlist story-scoped and artifact-specific; add adversarial tests with product source and arbitrary JSON.

preMortem.scenario: delivery_check_set or summary_set still leaves DONE blocked in TEST.
preMortem.trigger: Auto acknowledgement is written to a location not consumed by scope_contract_check or DONE oracle.
preMortem.consequence: Agents still need rollback repair; B-1261 bug remains.
preMortem.mitigation: Add an integration test that reaches TEST, writes delivery/summary, and verifies DONE precheck no longer reports those files.

preMortem.scenario: convergence_check hides real story/docs changes while avoiding .build.
preMortem.trigger: Ignore pattern is too broad or path matching is not anchored to derived directories.
preMortem.consequence: Convergence says true while requirements/story drift exists.
preMortem.mitigation: Test derived symlink loop skip and separate docs/story visible-change detection.

preMortem.scenario: session_brief still tells agents to advance DONE despite scope failure.
preMortem.trigger: Next-step priority logic remains phase-first instead of blocker-first.
preMortem.consequence: Agents loop on DONE or perform unnecessary rollback repair.
preMortem.mitigation: Add session_brief fixture/CLI test for blocking scope output and no DONE recommendation.
